calculation_method_source:
"""Finite ingestion-only analysis of preserved V31 outputs; no histories."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,csv,sys,datetime
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path('comparison_v31/package').resolve()))
import q042_comparison_v31 as m
P=Path('comparison_v31/package');R=Path('comparison_v31/raw');O=Path('ingest_v31');sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
e=m.ComparisonEvaluator(m.read(P/'initialized_context.json'));g=m.read(P/'native_grid_hex.json')['rows']
rows=list(csv.DictReader((P/'SHARED_PREFIX_nodes.csv').open()))
assert len(g)==len(rows)==28333
assert all(float(r['z'])==float.fromhex(v[0]) for r,v in zip(rows,g))
assert all(float.fromhex(g[i][0])<float.fromhex(g[i+1][0]) for i in range(len(g)-1))
index={float.fromhex(v[0]):i for i,v in enumerate(g)}
out={'q':'Q-042','date':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'kind':'CONDITIONAL_NECESSARY_FUNCTIONAL_CAP_FAILURE_FROM_PARTIAL_OUTPUT','new_trajectories':0,'new_tau_values':0,'claim_scope':'The unchanged frozen support_candidates policy applied to these retained interval nodes plus any admissible continuation contained in the received global rails. No claim about exact physical minimum, all alternative representations, original binary or science.','full_native_order':'increasing z; decreasing eta','excluded_final_index':28332,'excluded_final_z':float.fromhex(g[-1][0]),'cap':32,'proof':[],'frozen_file_hashes':{n:sha(P/n) for n in ['q042_comparison_v31.py','q042_comparison_support_v31.py','q042_arithmetic_audit_v31.py','q042_interval_v30.py','q042_comparison_contract_v31.json','q042_comparison_spec_post_v30.json','initialized_context.json','native_grid_hex.json','SHARED_PREFIX_nodes.csv']}}
for trial in ['UPPER','LOWER']:
 m.arithmetic.reset()
 nodes=[json.loads(s) for s in (R/trial/'nodes.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
 known={i:m.I(float(r['xe_source'])) for i,(v,r) in enumerate(zip(g,rows)) if float.fromhex(v[0])>50}
 for n in nodes:
  i=index[float.fromhex(n['z_hex'])]
  assert n['q']=='Q-042' and n['program_id']==m.PROGRAM_ID and n['config_sha256']==sha(P/'q042_comparison_contract_v31.json')
  known[i]=m.I(*n['sources']['xe_source']['decimal_bounds'])
 # Apply the actual final-index exclusion in original table order.
 eligible={i:v for i,v in known.items() if i<len(g)-1}
 M=min(v.hi for v in eligible.values());k=min(eligible,key=lambda i:eligible[i].hi)
 candidates=sorted(i for i,v in eligible.items() if v.lo<=M)
 missing=sorted(set(range(len(g)-1))-set(eligible))
 assert missing and missing==list(range(missing[-1]+1))
 zlast=float.fromhex(nodes[-1]['z_hex']);c=e.k['fHe']*e.k['helium'];xn=m.I(0,e.static['x_global_upper']['decimal_bounds'][1])+c
 tailz=m.I(0,zlast);xr=e.reio(tailz,xn,trial);sources=e.source_xe_dkappa(tailz,xn,xr)
 source=sources['xe_source'];boundary=float.fromhex(e.c['phase']['previous_limit'])-2*float.fromhex(e.c['phase']['smoothing_delta'])
 assert zlast<boundary and source.lo>M and len(candidates)>32
 assert all(float.fromhex(g[i][0])<=zlast for i in missing)
 assert m.arithmetic.snapshot()['direction_violations']==0
 # All missing interval nodes lie in the analytic x rail and source branch.
 # Inclusion-isotonic directed extension on subboxes lies in this box.
 # Therefore their lower and upper exports exceed M; none can reduce min_hi
 # or add candidates. M and the known candidate list persist unchanged.
 rec={'trial':trial,'retained_postentry_nodes':len(nodes),'remaining_eligible_nodes':len(missing),'known_eligible_nodes':len(eligible),'minimum_upper_bound':m.jsonable(m.I(M)),'minimum_upper_bound_index':k,'minimum_upper_bound_z':float.fromhex(g[k][0]),'candidate_count':len(candidates),'candidate_indices':candidates,'33_witnesses':[{'index':i,'z_hex':g[i][0],'xe_source_bounds':m.jsonable(eligible[i])} for i in candidates[:33]],'tail_domain_z':m.jsonable(tailz),'tail_xH_domain':m.jsonable(m.I(0,e.static['x_global_upper']['decimal_bounds'][1])),'tail_xe_source_bound':m.jsonable(source),'source_smoothing_boundary_z':boundary,'strict_margin_tail_lower_minus_M':m.jsonable(m.I(source.lo)-M),'arithmetic_evidence':m.arithmetic.snapshot(),'raw_node_sha256':sha(R/trial/'nodes.jsonl'),'gate':'FAIL_UNCHANGED_SUPPORT_CANDIDATE_CAP_IF_COMPLETED_WITHOUT_SHARPENING_PRIOR_INTERVALS','actual_tau_status':'NOT COMPUTED','actual_history_status':'PARTIAL_TIME_CAP','actual_functional_pipeline_status':'NOT_EXECUTED','proof_steps':['Exact full native table order and final-index exclusion recovered','Frozen shared prefix and every retained native source interval mapped by exact binary64 z','Every missing eligible point has z in the certified tail domain below the smoothing boundary','Global analytic x rail and frozen reio source evaluation give every missing node lower bound strictly above the existing minimum of upper bounds','Interval extension inclusion ensures admissible future subboxes do not reduce min_hi or add candidates','138/3002 existing conservative candidates therefore remain; cap32 fails for the unchanged stored-interval policy, independent of completion time']}
 out['proof'].append(rec)
out['interpretation']='This is an additional conditional mathematical incompatibility of the retained V31 interval representation with its fixed functional cap; it is not an executed tau test and does not prove that no different scientific-contract-preserving method can work.'
(O/'candidate_cap_certificate.json').write_text(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'q':'Q-042','status':'CONDITIONAL_CAP_FAILURE_PROVED_FOR_UNCHANGED_STORED_INTERVAL_POLICY','counts':[p['candidate_count'] for p in out['proof']],'thresholds':[p['minimum_upper_bound']['decimal_bounds'] for p in out['proof']],'tail_lower':[p['tail_xe_source_bound']['decimal_bounds'][0] for p in out['proof']],'new_trajectories':0,'new_tau':0},indent=2))
